newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 16.60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 16.60 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three month Treasury Bills dropped to 16.60 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 17.15 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Friday.
Applications for 76.7 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 96.07 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills dropped to 17.86 percent from 17.93 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 109.6 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 91.77 kwacha percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate rose to 18.71 form 18.43 two weeks ago. Applications for 69.1 million kwacha of bills on offer were also fully subscribed at the average price of 87.0 kwacha percent.
